description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Production Operations Lead - Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


As the Team Lead for Portuguese Sketches, you oversee the end-to-end production workflow, ensuring high-quality, scalable, and timely delivery of localized content. You lead a cross-functional team and ensure alignment between English and Portuguese Sketches while maintaining strict audio, visual, and subtitle quality standards.


In addition to overseeing production workflow, this role functions as a key operational stabilizer within the Portuguese content ecosystem. The Team lead ensures asset readiness, prevents production bottlenecks, bridges cross-time-zone collaboration, and safeguards content integrity across localized adaptations, enabling consistent and reliable execution at scale.


Key Responsibilities


Leadership & Workflow Management


  • Team Leadership & Workflow Management: Assign daily tasks, prioritize deliverables, and ensure smooth coordination across Video Editors and QC Specialists.


  • Production Continuity Ownership: Ensure editors are never blocked due to missing assets, incomplete folders, or lack of resource preparation. Proactively prepare videos, audios, scripts, and subtitles before daily production begins.


  • Cross-Team Asset Coordination: Act as liaison between Spanish/Portugeuse production, US content teams, and India stakeholders to request, follow up, and secure required assets in a timely manner.


  • Process Standardization: Develop and maintain internal documentation (SOPs, transition guides, tracking frameworks) to support workflow clarity, team alignment, and smooth leadership transitions.



Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management : Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Quality & Content Oversight


  • Quality Oversight: Ensure full synchronization between visuals, audio, and subtitles; consistent visual style; complete audio mix (vocals, music, SFX); and no unintended logos or asset errors.
  • English–Portuguese Alignment: Maintain narrative and visual coherence between source and localized content.
  • Content Integrity Assurance: Monitor alignment between English source content and Portuguese localized assets across motion episodes, still episodes, promo videos, and thumbnails to ensure narrative coherence and platform consistency.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.


  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.


Reporting, Assets & Documentation


  • Reporting & Performance Tracking: Submit daily performance reports and monitor output, quality, and timelines.


  • Asset & Process Management: Oversee asset organization, repository accuracy, and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and scalability.


  • Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain structured asset repositories, matching sheets, and tracking documents to ensure transparency and avoid duplication, inconsistencies, or production gaps.


Operations & Issue Resolution


  • Technical Issue Resolution: Address audio/video sync issues, asset inconsistencies, and day-to-day production challenges.
  • Daily Operational Troubleshooting: Resolve audio inconsistencies, subtitle mismatches, CMS issues, visual discrepancies, and asset errors to maintain high production standards.
  • Risk Prevention & Escalation: Identify operational risks (delays, inconsistencies, technical issues) early and escalate proactively to prevent impact on timelines and overall production output.



Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Production, Linguistics, Media, or a related field.
  • Intermediate to advanced English proficiency, with advanced knowledge of Portuguese grammar and orthography.
  • Proven experience in quality control, audio/video production, or a related content operations role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite (including Premiere); familiarity with CMS platforms required. Experience reviewing AI-generated content is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with a critical eye for audiovisual quality and consistency.
  • Demonstrated leadership and team management experience.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and time management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as operational backbone in high-volume content environments, ensuring production continuity and workflow stability.
  • Proven experience anticipating production risks (asset gaps, sync inconsistencies, narrative misalignment) and implementing preventive solutions before escalation.
  • Strong cross-cultural communication skills, with experience bridging expectations between international stakeholders (e.g., US and India teams) and local production teams.
  • Experience building structured documentation, repositories, and tracking systems that enhance team clarity and reduce operational friction.
  • Ability to maintain narrative and technical coherence despite creative divergence across markets.
  • High level of ownership and accountability over end-to-end production outcomes.
  • Strategic operational mindset with the ability to balance creative integrity, technical precision, and workflow efficiency.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)


Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (Long-Term)


About the Opportunity

We are seeking a kind, curious, and highly collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and building exceptional user experiences.

This team is responsible for creating seamless and compelling digital experiences that make it easy for customers to engage with a premium e-commerce and consignment platform. The engineering culture emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, individual growth, and professional development.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be both a hands-on technical contributor and a key influencer in shaping engineering direction. You will lead and contribute to significant initiatives, mentor fellow engineers through code reviews and pair programming, and help drive the evolution of a modern technology platform.

This opportunity is ideal for engineers passionate about luxury retail, e-commerce, sustainability, and circular economy business models.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable, performant, and testable software solutions.
  • Build and enhance customer-facing applications that directly support strategic business initiatives.
  • Contribute to technical architecture and engineering decisions that shape the future of the platform.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver impactful features.
  • Review pull requests and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to teammates.
  • Participate in pair programming and knowledge-sharing activities across the team.
  • Deploy production-ready code and support applications throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices.


Technology Stack

You will have the opportunity to work with a modern technology stack including:

  • Java
  • Kotlin
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • GraphQL
  • Kafka
  • AWS Lambda
  • PostgreSQL
  • DynamoDB

Legacy services currently include:

  • Ruby on Rails
  • Elixir
  • React


Required Experience & Skills

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin, along with experience working in Ruby on Rails environments.
  • Expertise in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript), HTML, and CSS.
  • Experience building applications with React and related ecosystem tools, including Node.js and npm.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, IDEs, version control systems, and deployment tools.
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures, GraphQL, and database design fundamentals.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a user-centric engineering mindset.
  • Interest in retail, e-commerce, luxury consignment, sustainability, or circular economy business models.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or maintaining Kafka-based event streaming solutions.
  • Experience working with Elixir.
  • Experience decomposing monolithic applications into microservices.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.


What Makes You Successful

  • You are curious, adaptable, and continuously seek opportunities to learn.
  • You thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy mentoring fellow engineers.
  • You balance technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making.
  • You care deeply about delivering value to users through technology.
  • You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven organization focused on sustainability and premium resale experiences.

title: Contract Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role: Contract Specialist

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Duration: Long term


Required Skills & Experience


  • Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management (intake, drafting, negotiation support, execution, and archiving), and utilizing contract management system(s)
  • Experience drafting and redlining contracts using standard templates (e.g., MSAs, SOWs, Order Forms, Amendments, SaaS/IT Agreements)
  • Ability to identify non-standard terms and escalate risks appropriately
  • Familiarity with using fallback positions and negotiation playbooks
  • Working knowledge of Source-to-Pay process; understanding of procurement roles and approvals Experience supporting indirect procurement


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • IT background is preferred


Job Description

Client is looking for a Contract Specialist to support the full contract lifecycle, including intake, drafting, review coordination, and execution tracking for procurement-related indirect agreements. At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

  • Great problem-solving skills

Nice to have

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly*

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

We are a forward-thinking technology organization dedicated to developing innovative software solutions that improve outcomes for clients and end-users. Our engineering team designs, builds, and maintains scalable, high-quality applications that drive efficiency and innovation across industries. We are seeking an experienced Level III Software Engineer (contractor) to join our distributed team, contributing to complex projects with a focus on code quality, security, and collaboration.


Position Overview

As a Level III Software Engineer (contractor), you will apply your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects. Working remotely with a U.S.-based team, you'll gain deep system knowledge and contribute to an Agile development workflow using Azure DevOps.

You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews, expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. The role will continue to evolve based on your strengths and project needs, while maintaining rigorous adherence to coding and security standards.


Key Responsibilities

  • Product Design & Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to design and implement software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Code Contributions: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancement of existing codebases, beginning around months 3–4.
  • Testing & Quality: Design and implement automated end-to-end (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability—especially during the first 6–9 months.
  • Peer Reviews: Participate in pre-release feature reviews and early post-release bug analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.
  • Agile Workflow Participation: Actively contribute to sprints, pull requests, and releases within a 2-week sprint / 6-week release cycle using Azure DevOps.
  • Collaboration: Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members across multiple time zones.


Qualifications


Experience

  • 5–8 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated record of success on complex projects.


Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Applications (.NET 8) , leveraging web expertise for cross-platform or mobile development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure App Service, Azure SQL, and Azure Storage.
  • Strong understanding of modern development tools (e.g., Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and general cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies .


Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.


Preferred

  • Experience with regulated or data-sensitive software environments (e.g., healthcare, financial services, HIPAA, PHI).
  • Prior experience conducting pull-request reviews and participating in Agile sprints.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on impactful, large-scale technology projects.
  • Collaborative, high-performance engineering culture focused on quality and innovation.
  • Flexible remote work environment with a structured onboarding process for success.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: Two-week sprints within a six-week release cycle, including daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT), sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tool Stack: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and related technologies.
  • Team Culture: A focus on accountability, collaboration, and excellence in delivery.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Software Engineer (Go) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Together with the Zoolatech team, our partner, a leading construction management company, is at the forefront of developing a cloud-based software solution. This innovative platform is instrumental in the successful completion of major projects including skyscrapers, hospitals, data centers, stadiums, and schools. It streamlines the management of finances, quality, teams, and risks, making these processes transparent, convenient, and regulation-compliant. Our partner is not only an expert in construction management but also a significant technology innovator, actively developing web and mobile solutions.


Currently Directory business unit owns user identity and access management across their entire platform ecosystem. They've just launched a brand-new Go-based service into closed beta — a ground-up rebuild of how users and companies are managed across the platform. It's live, but not yet actively used. The work ahead is substantial: migrating data and business logic out of a Ruby monolith, building new features in parallel, and accelerating the service toward full production ownership. Now we are looking for reinforcement for the team to develop the new service and help with the migration from the legacy platform.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain backend services in Go, implementing event-driven systems governed by CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Drive migration of business logic and data from the Ruby legacy monolith into the new Go service
  • Contribute to the new service while it moves from closed beta toward becoming authoritative — building ongoing features in parallel with migration
  • Develop and extend GraphQL Federation schemas that power the federated API gateway
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and UX to design and build solutions that address user and company management challenges
  • Use a systems engineering approach to make technical design decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability
  • Write highly performant code that supports a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS architecture
  • Conduct code reviews, provide mentorship, and actively drive engineering excellence across the team
  • Communicate complex technical problems and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Skills Required

  • 5+ years in Software Engineering across full-stack distributed applications
  • 3+ years of hands-on Go in production microservices
  • Experience with CQRS and event sourcing patterns
  • Experience with Kafka or similar distributed event streaming platforms
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, including data modeling and query optimization
  • Familiarity with GraphQL, including schema design
  • Working knowledge of React and TypeScript for frontend contributions
  • Comfort working across the full development lifecycle: design, testing, staging, deployment, monitoring
  • Strong communication skills — ability to collaborate across US and international time zones
  • US time zone or compatible overlap (EST/CST);

Would be a huge plus:

  • Experience with Ruby/Rails systems, including incremental refactoring and modernization


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)


This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.


To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.


Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role: Senior Salesforce & AWS Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Duration: Multi-year engagement


Position Overview

Insight Global is seeking multiple Senior Salesforce & AWS Developers to support a large-scale healthcare client (Sevita). This is a highly technical, hands-on role within a custom, enterprise environment where Salesforce serves as the system of record and AWS powers complex data processing and integrations.

The team is looking for proven, senior-level developers who can contribute immediately, own enhancements, and operate across both Salesforce and AWS ecosystems with minimal ramp-up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and enhance Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning, and custom components
  • Build and maintain AWS-based services for data extraction, transformation, and distribution
  • Integrate Salesforce with AWS services and downstream systems via REST APIs
  • Support data flows to external partners, mobile applications, and state systems
  • Own performance tuning, enhancements, and production support across platforms
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and release management
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a highly customized, homegrown environment
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and integration issues


Required Qualifications

  • 5–7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong Salesforce expertise across:
  • Apex, LWC, Visualforce, Aura
  • SOQL, SOSL
  • Flows, triggers, controllers, Lightning Apps
  • Experience with custom objects, validation rules, workflows, reports, dashboards
  • Experience with SFDX, deployments, and Salesforce administration tasks
  • Strong experience with AWS development
  • Proficiency in:
  • Node.js, Lambda, API Gateway
  • SNS, SQS, IAM, Secrets Manager
  • S3, DynamoDB, RDS
  • Route 53 and networking fundamentals
  • Strong experience with REST API integrations
  • Experience with CI/CD, build & deployment processes, and application security
  • Understanding of AWS architecture (regions, availability zones, monitoring tools )
  • Experience with CloudFormation and SAM deployments
  • Ability to support large, complex enterprise systems across multiple projects


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with React.js or front-end frameworks
  • Exposure to Amplify or modern AWS full-stack tooling
  • Familiarity with EventBridge or event-driven architectures
  • Experience with automation or scripting (Groovy, CLI tools, etc.)
  • Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud / Data 360


What Success Looks Like

  • Immediate contribution to ongoing development and enhancements
  • Reliable and scalable Salesforce + AWS integrations
  • High-quality, secure, and performant application delivery
  • Strong ownership of production issues and system improvements
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, highly customized environment


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, highly hands-on developer with deep Salesforce expertise
  • Strong AWS builder with real-world development experience (not just exposure)
  • Thrives in custom, non-standard enterprise environments
  • Proven ability to ramp quickly and deliver impact immediately
  • Detail-oriented and technically credible (must be fully vetted/verified candidates)

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses

Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Strategist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a leading brand in health supplements for women over 40. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for women going through menopause by solving real, everyday challenges—weight gain, hot flashes, insomnia, mood shifts, and more.


We’re looking for a Creative Strategist with strong persuasive advertising and copywriting expertise to own the ideation and messaging that drives performance. You’ll turn customer insights, performance data, and market awareness into high-converting creative angles, scripts, and messaging systems that scale.


Responsibilities

Creative Strategy

  • Contribute to the development of creative strategy for paid social, grounded in direct-response principles
  • Translate performance data, customer research, and competitive insights into effective copy frameworks and angles
  • Support the creation of ad concepts and scalable creative approaches
  • Participate in brainstorming and help shape a testing roadmap of angles, messages, and formats based on clear hypotheses
  • Help maintain creative standards to ensure consistent brand voice and persuasive quality across ads, landing pages, and funnels


Performance & Media Buying Integration

  • Use platform learnings and audience behavior to shape creative testing and copy direction.
  • Build feedback loops so creative evolves weekly based on performance data across ads


AI & Creative Innovation

  • Experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate creative research and performance testing.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs and prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).


Qualifications

  • Experience in creative strategy, performance creative, or e-commerce marketing.
  • Hands-on experience with direct-response copywriting
  • Direct experience with women’s wellness, supplements, or health-related products strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to prepare structured briefs/prompts for AI-generated ad creatives (e.g., scripts, hooks, visuals, UGC-style ads).
  • Strong portfolio of paid social creative with proven ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Working hours

  • 6am - 2pm EST (Monday - Friday)
  • Fully-remote


Compensation

  • $3,500 to $5,000/month


If you think you might be a good fit, please apply.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Engenheiro de dados S
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de dados S em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Analista Financeiro Contador(a)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista Financeiro Contador(a) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ANALISTA FINANCEIRO CONTADOR(A)

  • 100% remoto
  • Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição
  • Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar
  • Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimento


SOBRE A ADAFLOW

A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.


Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.


Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.


Conheça mais em:


Agora, a área financeira está amadurecendo junto com a empresa. Hoje muita coisa roda no braço, em planilha, dependendo de uma pessoa só, e é aí que você entra. A proposta aqui é diferente: você pega uma base ainda em construção e a organiza e estrutura com método e autonomia.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Seu papel é transformar uma operação manual em uma rotina contábil limpa, confiável e fechada no mês. Na prática, isso significa:

  • Finalizar a parametrização das contas e das regras do sistema contábil, dando sequência ao que já foi iniciado e garantindo que tudo reflita o modelo de negócio da Adaflow.
  • Revisar todas as contas e regras cadastradas, conferindo se batem com a operação real da empresa antes de colocar em produção.
  • Participar dos treinamentos do Oneflow pra dominar a ferramenta com autonomia e depender cada vez menos de suporte externo.
  • Documentar a parametrização e montar o \"manual de contas\" interno da Adaflow, deixando tudo padronizado e fácil de consultar pelo time.
  • Fazer os lançamentos contábeis mensais, zerando o acúmulo e mantendo a contabilidade sempre em dia.
  • Cuidar dos lançamentos diários no sistema financeiro, mantendo o registro consistente e atualizado.
  • Fazer a triagem das notas fiscais, garantindo o registro e a rastreabilidade total de cada documento (Drive/sistema).
  • Integrar as rotinas do financeiro com a contabilidade, deixando o fluxo de dados entre as áreas mais fluido.
  • Conferir todos os dias se as importações automáticas estão rodando certinho no Oneflow.
  • Acompanhar a consistência dos lançamentos automáticos do financeiro para o contábil, corrigindo qualquer irregularidade antes que vire problema.
  • Identificar e corrigir anomalias nos lançamentos antes que gerem inconsistências, sempre entendendo o porquê de cada movimentação.
  • Manter a conciliação entre financeiro e contabilidade rigorosamente em dia, pra fechar tudo no próprio mês de competência.
  • Propor melhorias no processo de importação de dados pra reduzir erros e retrabalho.


O QUE A GENTE PROCURA

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
  • Experiência sólida em contabilidade de empresas de prestação de serviços, com foco em lançamentos, conciliação e escrituração;
  • Conhecimento do fluxo de notas fiscais para prestadores de serviço PJ;
  • Capacidade de identificar anomalias em lançamentos contábeis com autonomia e olhar investigativo;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas contábeis e ERPs financeiros (Oneflow, Omie, Domínio, Conta Azul, Totvs ou similares);
  • Nível avançado de Excel/Google Sheets para importação e conferência de dados;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, criar dashboards e propor melhorias;
  • Atenção meticulosa a detalhes e ritmo para rotina com prazos recorrentes;
  • Discrição e responsabilidade no trato de dados financeiros sensíveis;
  • Organização e método para manter registros e rotinas em ordem;
  • Autonomia, proatividade e orientação a resultados para atuar em ambiente remoto e dinâmico;
  • Curiosidade ativa com IA: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • CRC ativo;
  • Experiência com Omie ou sistemas similares;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Domínio;
  • Vivência em startups SaaS ou negócios de receita recorrente;
  • Curva de aprendizado rápida para dominar novos sistemas.

  • Estruturar planos de trabalho e fluxos de execução.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e entregas.

  • Produzir atas, encaminhamentos e planos de ação.
  • Realizar acompanhamento cotidiano dos projetos.
  • Garantir que expectativas, escopo e cronogramas estejam alinhados entre cliente e equipe.

Processos e Melhoria Contínua

  • Alimentar ferramentas de gestão.
  • Produzir relatórios de acompanhamento.
  • Sugerir melhorias operacionais.
  • Contribuir para a padronização de fluxos, documentos e rotinas.

Conhecimento obrigatório em:

  • Google Workspace
  • Excel ou Google Sheets


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com clientes de sustentabilidade, terceiro setor ou organismos internacionais.
  • Conhecimento básico de CRM.
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada à produtividade e gestão, ESPECIALMENTE CLAUDE.


Competências comportamentais

Organização extrema

Consegue administrar simultaneamente dezenas de entregas, projetos e interlocutores sem perder controle de prioridades.

Capacidade de coordenação

Tem habilidade para mobilizar pessoas, cobrar retornos e manter os projetos em movimento sem gerar ruídos desnecessários.

Comunicação clara

Consegue traduzir demandas, alinhar expectativas e facilitar a comunicação entre diferentes áreas.

Senso de urgência

Entende a diferença entre o que é importante, urgente e estratégico.

Proatividade

Antecipar problemas é mais importante do que reagir a eles.

Inteligência relacional

Lida bem com clientes, equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes estilos de trabalho.


Indicadores de desempenho

  • Percentual de entregas realizadas dentro do prazo.
  • Taxa de retrabalho.
  • Cumprimento dos cronogramas dos projetos.
  • Satisfação dos clientes.
  • Nível de ocupação e distribuição equilibrada da equipe.
  • Tempo médio de resposta às demandas.
  • Qualidade dos registros, atas e controles operacionais.
  • Redução de gargalos e atrasos recorrentes.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Como parte de uma equipe global de tecnologia, o(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior atuará no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de produtos de dados em ambiente Cloud. O profissional será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e escalabilidade dos dados utilizados pela organização.


A posição exige forte atuação em projetos de dados utilizando plataformas como Azure e Snowflake, além de colaboração constante com arquitetos, times ágeis e stakeholders de negócio para entrega de soluções analíticas de alto valor.


Principais Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Cloud.

• Desenvolver pipelines de dados batch e streaming utilizando plataformas Azure e Snowflake.

• Implementar processos de extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT) provenientes de múltiplas fontes.

• Garantir a qualidade, governança e integridade dos dados ao longo de todo o ciclo de processamento.

• Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando Snowflake, dbt e tecnologias do ecossistema Azure.

• Construir e otimizar consultas SQL, procedures e rotinas de processamento de dados.

• Implementar integrações entre diferentes sistemas e fontes de dados corporativas.

• Participar de provas de conceito (POCs), avaliações técnicas e demonstrações de novas tecnologias.

Colaboração e Entrega de Projetos

• Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de negócio, arquitetos de soluções e times técnicos para levantamento de requisitos e definição de soluções.

• Traduzir necessidades de negócio em modelos de dados, fluxos automatizados e soluções escaláveis.

• Garantir aderência às melhores práticas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, governança e segurança de dados.

• Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e processos de melhoria contínua.

DevOps e Qualidade

• Atuar seguindo práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e padrões de desenvolvimento estabelecidos pela organização.

• Utilizar ferramentas de versionamento e gestão de código-fonte, como GitHub e Azure DevOps.

• Apoiar processos de automação, testes e monitoramento das soluções desenvolvidas.

• Contribuir para a evolução contínua da plataforma de dados e das práticas de engenharia adotadas pela equipe.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados (mínimo de 5 anos).

• Experiência prática com Snowflake.

• Conhecimento sólido em SQL, incluindo consultas complexas e stored procedures.

• Conhecimento sólido em dbt (Data Build Tool).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines ETL/ELT em ambiente Cloud.

• Experiência com serviços Azure, incluindo ADF, Functions, Event Hub e Azure DevOps.

• Conhecimento em Python para desenvolvimento e automação de processos de dados.

• Conhecimento de modelagem de dados

• Experiência com práticas de CI/CD, DevOps e versionamento de código utilizando GitHub.

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou Kanban).

• Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente corporativo global.

Diferenciais

• Experiência com ferramentas de replicação de dados, como Qlik Replicate, SLT ou Click.

• Experiência em projetos de Data & Analytics.

• Conhecimento em SQL Server e otimização de consultas.

• Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados, como Power BI ou Tableau será um diferencial.

• Experiência com plataformas de streaming de dados, como Kafka.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Application Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Application Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

  • Experience in ADAS/AV V&V, testing, and simulation.
  • Previous experience in customer facing engineering such as Field Application Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services, or related positions.
  • Running and working with ADAS/AV Simulators, e.g. Carla, Sumo, Carmaker, Vires, etc...
  • Employee in one of the ADAS/AV companies, or one of the companies serving them.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager / Methodology Engineer.
  • Knowledge & experience with ADAS/AV verification.
  • Knowledge & experience with advanced verification, and specifically with Specman and the ‘e’ language, and/or SystemVerilog UVM, Perspec PSS, and Coverage Driven Verification.
  • MSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Substantial experience in Software Engineering, including OO programming.

We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. Sobre a vaga:

O DevOps será responsável por projetar, implantar e manter soluções de monitoramento, telemetria e rastreabilidade em ambientes Azure, garantindo visibilidade completa sobre aplicações, containers e serviços serverless.


Responsabilidades:

  • Deverá configurar e integrar ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights, estabelecendo padrões de observabilidade que suportem o diagnóstico de incidentes, análise de desempenho e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Atuará na automação de monitoramento via IaC, integração com pipelines DevOps e na definição de métricas de confiabilidade (SLO/SLI/SLA) para aplicações críticas.
  • Será responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery e Change Failure Rate), promovendo uma cultura orientada a dados e melhoria contínua na entrega de software.


Requisitos:

  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights.
  • Coleta e correlação de logs, métricas e traces.
  • Observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Functions, Logic Apps, App Services).
  • Observabilidade de containers e clusters AKS (Kubernetes).
  • Criação de dashboards e alertas personalizados (KQL, Workbooks, Grafana).
  • Integração de Application Insights com pipelines DevOps e ferramentas de APM.
  • Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM) e rastreamento distribuído.
  • Conceitos de SLA, SLO e SLI e aplicação prática em ambientes produtivos.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM) para provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade.
  • Automação de alertas e incidentes com Logic Apps, Azure Functions e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento de containers, Kubernetes, Helm e Prometheus.
  • Métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) e integração com pipelines DevOps.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Golang Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a global leader in the meal kit delivery industry that helps millions of customers cook healthy, homemade meals without the stress of meal planning or grocery shopping.


As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.


Responsibilities


  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments


Engagement Model: Direct Independent Contractor (Please read carefully)

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment


Please note that only candidates whose profiles closely match our requirements will be contacted.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.
